title: Compound and Nested Conditions
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of compound and nested conditions using at least one correct term from the lesson.

Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Compound and Nested Conditions** as part of **Decision-Making and Loops**. Apply compound and nested conditions by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—Combining Conditions, Nested if and when, Simplifying Complex Boolean Logic—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.
